ValidationRule.description: US-23/US-30: every lead records why the customer came (Enquiry or Purchase); a purchase also records the vehicle model they want.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(IsConverted), OR( ISBLANK(TEXT(Visit_Purpose__c)), AND(ISPICKVAL(Visit_Purpose__c, "Purchase"), ISBLANK(Vehicle_Model_Of_Interest__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Choose the Visit Purpose (Enquiry or Purchase). If the customer came to buy, also choose the Vehicle of Interest.
